news.titleEn: Oil prices fall as traders hope for diplomatic progress in Middle East
news.conclusionEn: Brent settled 0.7% lower at $108.79 and expiring November WTI fell 1.8% to $101.79, after both swung wildly from session highs near $112 and $110 on conflicting US-Iran headlines.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊谈判传闻反复，布油日内冲高112美元后回落收于108.79
news.whyEn: Swings of more than $6 in a single session show how fragile supply is: at least 18 ships have been attacked near Hormuz in two weeks, and every move feeds straight into fuel costs and inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 单日振幅超6美元，霍尔木兹两周内至少18艘船遇袭，油价直接牵动全球通胀
news.detailEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two 'non-compliant' tankers were set ablaze after hitting mines it had laid in the strait, and Tehran warned it would answer any US strike 'in equal measure, if not more forcefully.' Hopes for a diplomatic breakthrough nonetheless pulled prices off their highs. Analysts noted the strength in front-month WTI before expiry signals a tight physical market as Middle East exports shrink. The US decision to exempt Russia's shadow fleet from new sanctions may lower freight rates and let more Russian crude reach buyers.
news.detailZh: 伊朗革命卫队称两艘「不配合」的油轮触雷起火，德黑兰并警告将「同等甚至更强烈地」回应美国任何打击。不过外交突破的期待仍把油价从高位拉回。分析师指出，WTI近月合约在到期前走强，说明中东出口减少下实货市场偏紧。美国豁免俄罗斯「影子船队」的新制裁，可能压低运费、让更多俄油流向买家。

news.titleEn: Musk says Tesla and SpaceX formed special committees to discuss merger: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: SpaceX's third-quarter revenue jumped 161% to $14.58 billion, beating forecasts, and Musk revealed both companies' boards have formed independent committees to weigh a Tesla-SpaceX merger.
news.conclusionZh: SpaceX三季度营收暴增161%，马斯克称特斯拉与SpaceX已组委员会讨论合并
news.whyEn: A merger would combine two of the world's most valuable companies; SpaceX's strong AI-infrastructure numbers also lifted chip and AI stocks across Asia.
news.whyZh: 合并将打造全球最大科技集团之一；SpaceX亮眼业绩也带动亚洲AI芯片股反弹
news.detailEn: SpaceX beat estimates with $14.58 billion in revenue versus $12.72 billion expected, and its shares rose about 7% after hours. Starlink subscribers rose to 13.6 million with average revenue per user of $69. Musk said the special committees are made up of independent directors because he is a conflicted party, and noted a Tesla deal would need approval from 50% of all outstanding shares, 'quite a high hurdle.' He also said SpaceX aims for volume production of AI chips with Tesla and Intel by the third quarter of 2028.
news.detailZh: SpaceX营收145.8亿美元，远超预期的127.2亿美元，盘后股价涨约7%。星链用户增至1360万，每用户平均收入69美元。马斯克表示，因为他本人存在利益冲突，特别委员会由独立董事组成；特斯拉一方需获得全部流通股50%的赞成票，门槛「相当高」。他还说SpaceX计划在2028年第三季度与特斯拉、英特尔一起实现AI芯片量产。

news.titleEn: Dow jumps 500 points as earnings optimism steadies market: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The Dow rose 529.85 points (1.02%) to 52,495.88 and the S&P 500 gained 0.28% on strong earnings and lower oil, while the Nasdaq was flat.
news.conclusionZh: 财报利好叠加油价回落，道指大涨530点
news.whyEn: Solid results from industrials like 3M and Northrop Grumman are offsetting worries about debt-funded AI spending, giving the market a broader base of support.
news.whyZh: 3M、诺格等传统企业财报强劲，缓解了市场对AI举债扩张的担忧
news.detailEn: 3M jumped more than 5% after beating estimates and raising its full-year guidance, and Northrop Grumman gained more than 4% on an earnings beat. Lower oil prices added to a decline in Treasury yields. Tech sentiment was hit early when Korean AI firm Elice plunged more than 30% in its debut, but storage and AI names such as Western Digital and CoreWeave recovered later in the session. Investors are now waiting for Magnificent Seven earnings, starting with Meta after the close on Wednesday.
news.detailZh: 3M业绩超预期并上调全年指引，股价涨逾5%；诺斯罗普·格鲁曼业绩超预期，涨逾4%。油价回落也带动美债收益率下行。韩国AI公司Elice上市首日暴跌逾30%，一度打击科技股情绪，但西部数据、CoreWeave等存储和AI股随后回升。市场接下来关注「七巨头」财报，Meta将于周三盘后率先发布。

news.titleEn: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
news.conclusionEn: Netflix earned 87 cents a share on in-line revenue of $12.87 billion, but its shares fell about 6% after hours as it guided full-year revenue to the low end of its range.
news.conclusionZh: 奈飞三季度利润超预期，但全年营收指引偏低，盘后跌约6%
news.whyEn: Stagnating viewership and competition from YouTube are testing whether price hikes and advertising can keep growth going for the streaming leader.
news.whyZh: 观看时长停滞、YouTube竞争加剧，考验奈飞靠提价和广告维持增长的能力
news.detailEn: Net income rose to $3.66 billion from $2.55 billion a year earlier, helped partly by the timing of expenses. Revenue grew almost 12%, boosted by membership growth and price increases that took effect in March. Netflix expects fourth-quarter revenue of $13.44 billion and narrowed its 2026 forecast to $51.1 billion, below Wall Street's $51.2 billion. Management said strategic clarity and execution are critical given the explosion of content competing for consumer attention.
news.detailZh: 净利润由去年同期的25.5亿美元升至36.6亿美元，部分得益于费用确认时点。营收增长近12%，主要来自会员增长和3月起的提价。奈飞预计第四季度营收134.4亿美元，并把2026年全年预期收窄至511亿美元，低于华尔街预期的512亿美元。管理层表示，在海量内容争夺用户注意力的情况下，战略清晰和执行到位至关重要。

news.titleEn: Oil parked above $110 a barrel as IEA warns energy markets won’t return to normal next year
news.conclusionEn: IEA chief Fatih Birol said he sees no credible path for energy markets to normalise in 2027, warning that Hormuz 'can be closed again.'
news.conclusionZh: IEA署长比罗尔警告：2027年能源市场看不到恢复正常的可能
news.whyEn: It signals elevated energy costs could last well into 2027, hurting importers, airlines and consumers. Houthi attacks have already pushed Saudi Arabia to call off its flagship investor conference.
news.whyZh: 高能源成本或延续到2027年；沙特已因胡塞袭击取消旗舰投资大会
news.detailEn: Speaking at an industry event in London, Birol said he is very worried about 'overlapping crises' in the Middle East that could escalate further. Iran has issued public threats to deter Washington from restarting the stalemated war, while Iran-backed Houthi militants have carried out deadly attacks inside Saudi Arabia. The attacks disrupted oil shipments and led Riyadh to cancel its flagship investor conference a week before it was due to start. Oil is still leaving the region, but at reduced and volatile volumes.
news.detailZh: 比罗尔在伦敦的行业会议上表示，他非常担心中东「多重危机叠加」并进一步升级。伊朗公开发出威胁，试图阻止美国重启目前僵持的战争；伊朗支持的胡塞武装则在沙特境内发动了致命袭击。这些袭击干扰了石油运输，沙特还在开幕前一周取消了旗舰投资大会。中东原油仍在外运，但规模缩小且很不稳定。

news.titleEn: Stock futures rise as traders evaluate latest raft of earnings; SpaceX shares surge: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: Asian tech stocks rebounded on Wednesday as SpaceX's results revived the AI trade: SK Hynix rose about 6%, Samsung 5%, and the Kospi and Nikkei opened sharply higher.
news.conclusionZh: SpaceX业绩提振AI信心，周三亚洲科技股大反弹，SK海力士涨逾6%
news.whyEn: It follows a bruising selloff, including a 4% drop in the Kospi on Tuesday, and shows how much Asian chip stocks depend on confidence in US AI spending.
news.whyZh: 韩股前一日刚跌4%，这次反弹说明亚洲芯片股高度依赖美国AI投资情绪
news.detailEn: Korean AI infrastructure firm Elice soared nearly 30% after plunging more than 30% in its debut, while Japan's Advantest gained 5.3% and SoftBank Group rose 4.7%. Separately, Japan's September exports grew 16.7% year on year, well below the 20.1% Reuters poll forecast and the second straight month of slowing growth. Semiconductor shipments were still a bright spot, up 49.4% by value. US stock futures also rose overnight as investors digested strong earnings.
news.detailZh: 韩国AI基础设施公司Elice上市首日暴跌逾30%后反弹近30%；日本爱德万测试涨5.3%，软银集团涨4.7%。另外，日本9月出口同比增长16.7%，远低于路透调查预期的20.1%，已连续第二个月放缓，但半导体出口额仍大增49.4%。美股期货隔夜也因财报强劲走高。

news.titleEn: ‘Tariff Man’ finally found tariffs he doesn’t like
news.conclusionEn: Trump signed an order waiving new Russia sanctions and tariffs of up to 500% on Russian imports and 100% on top buyers of Russian oil, two days before they were due to take effect.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普豁免对俄最高500%关税及针对俄油买家的100%关税
news.whyEn: The waiver eases pressure on big buyers of Russian energy such as India and China and on global oil supply, but it sparked bipartisan backlash and weakens Ukraine's position.
news.whyZh: 利好俄油买家并缓解供应紧张，但引发两党强烈反对，削弱乌克兰处境
news.detailEn: The penalties came from a sanctions law named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham that Trump signed in September. Raymond James analyst Ed Mills said the move 'eviscerates any real enforcement' of the law and is an awkward closing argument weeks before the midterms. The waiver followed an October 9 deal for Russia to supply more diesel to US and global markets. Oil traders expect the decision to allow more Russian barrels to flow and possibly lower freight rates.
news.detailZh: 这些惩罚措施来自特朗普9月签署、以已故参议员林赛·格雷厄姆命名的制裁法案。Raymond James分析师Ed Mills称，此举「掏空了」该法的实际执行力，而且在中期选举前几周显得很尴尬。此前，美俄已于10月9日达成协议，由俄罗斯向美国和全球市场增供柴油。油市预计这一豁免会让更多俄油流入市场，运费也可能下降。

news.titleEn: Pakistan’s army chief in Tehran: Can diplomacy prevent new US–Iran fighting?
news.conclusionEn: Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir flew to Tehran to try to revive US-Iran talks, a day after Russia's Lavrov visited and as President Pezeshkian demanded sanctions be lifted before any negotiations.
news.conclusionZh: 巴基斯坦陆军参谋长赴德黑兰斡旋，伊朗坚持先解除制裁再谈判
news.whyEn: Whether talks resume decides if the Strait of Hormuz reopens fully, which is the single biggest driver of oil prices and global inflation risk right now.
news.whyZh: 谈判能否重启，决定霍尔木兹海峡能否全面恢复通航，牵动油价和全球通胀
news.detailEn: This is Munir's fifth visit to Iran since the April ceasefire that Islamabad brokered, and he is accompanied by Pakistan's interior minister. The talks have stalled despite a memorandum of understanding signed in June, and Iran says not even a tiny amount of enriched uranium will leave the country. Russia's foreign minister Lavrov pledged Moscow's support in Tehran a day earlier. Trump has said US forces will not attack Iran before the November 3 midterms.
news.detailZh: 这是蒙尼尔自4月巴方斡旋停火以来第五次访问伊朗，巴基斯坦内政部长随行。尽管双方6月签署了谅解备忘录，谈判仍陷入僵局；伊朗表示「哪怕一点浓缩铀也不会运出国」。前一天，俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫在德黑兰表态支持伊朗。特朗普此前表示，美军在11月3日中期选举前不会攻击伊朗。

news.titleEn: Alberta voters reject move toward separation from Canada in referendum
news.conclusionEn: About three-quarters of Alberta voters rejected starting a process toward separation from Canada, a clear victory for Prime Minister Mark Carney.
news.conclusionZh: 阿尔伯塔约四分之三选民拒绝启动独立程序，卡尼获胜
news.whyEn: Alberta holds the world's fourth-largest proven oil reserves; the result removes a major political risk for Canada's energy sector and the Canadian dollar amid Trump's trade war.
news.whyZh: 阿省坐拥全球第四大石油储量，结果消除了加拿大能源业和加元的重大政治风险
news.detailEn: With more than 1 million votes counted, about 76% backed remaining in Canada versus 23% for beginning a process that could lead to a second, binding separation vote. Turnout was high, with more than 1.35 million Albertans casting advance or special ballots. Resentment toward Ottawa runs deep in the oil-rich, conservative province, but has not translated into majority support for independence. The vote came amid Trump's trade war and annexation threats toward Canada.
news.detailZh: 在已统计的逾100万张选票中，约76%支持留在加拿大，23%支持启动可能通向第二次、具约束力独立公投的程序。投票踊跃，逾135万选民提前投票或以特殊方式投票。这个石油资源丰富、政治保守的省份对渥太华积怨已久，但并未转化为多数人支持独立。投票正值特朗普对加拿大发动贸易战并发出吞并威胁之际。

businessTips.explanationEn: When a controlling shareholder or CEO sits on both sides of a deal, the board forms a special committee of independent directors to negotiate and approve it. The committee can hire its own bankers and lawyers and can say no. This protects minority shareholders and makes the deal much harder to challenge in court. The point is that the person with the conflict steps out of the decision.
businessTips.explanationZh: 当控股股东或CEO同时站在交易双方时，董事会会组建一个由独立董事组成的特别委员会，负责谈判和批准交易。委员会可以自己聘请投行和律师，也有权否决。这能保护小股东，也让交易在法律上更难被挑战。核心是：有利益冲突的人要退出决策。
businessTips.exampleEn: Musk runs both Tesla and SpaceX, so both boards set up committees of independent directors to study a merger without him in the room. In a small company, the same idea applies when a founder wants to buy services from a firm owned by a relative: let a disinterested partner approve the terms.
businessTips.exampleZh: 马斯克同时掌管特斯拉和SpaceX，所以两家公司都成立了独立董事委员会研究合并，他本人不参与。小公司也一样：如果创始人想采购亲戚公司的服务，就该交给没有利益关系的合伙人来批准条款。

businessTips.explanationEn: A referral loop is when existing customers bring in new ones, often in exchange for a reward. The viral coefficient K equals invites sent per user times the conversion rate of those invites. If K is above 1, each customer brings in more than one new customer and growth compounds by itself. Even a K of 0.3 to 0.5 meaningfully lowers your average customer acquisition cost.
businessTips.explanationZh: 推荐循环是指老客户带来新客户，通常会给一定奖励。病毒系数K = 每个用户发出的邀请数 × 邀请转化率。K大于1时，每个客户带来不止一个新客户，增长会自我滚动。即使K只有0.3到0.5，也能明显降低平均获客成本。
businessTips.exampleEn: An online course seller offers a $20 credit to anyone whose friend enrolls. If each student invites 3 friends and 15% enroll, K = 0.45, meaning every 100 paid students bring in 45 more for free. Raising the conversion with a discount for the invited friend can push K higher.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个卖网课的人给每位成功推荐朋友报名的学员20美元抵扣。如果每位学员邀请3个朋友、转化率15%，K = 0.45，也就是每100个付费学员会免费带来45个新学员。给被邀请的朋友也发优惠、提高转化率，K还能更高。

businessTips.explanationEn: Futures contracts have expiry dates, so traders who want to keep a position must close the expiring month and buy the next one, which is called rolling. Near expiry, the front-month price can move sharply and differ a lot from the next month because physical supply and demand dominate. Commodity ETFs that hold futures gain or lose on every roll, so their returns can drift away from the spot price.
businessTips.explanationZh: 期货合约有到期日，想继续持仓的交易者必须平掉即将到期的合约、买入下一个月份，这叫「展期」。临近到期时，近月价格可能剧烈波动，并和下月合约差距很大，因为此时实货供需起主导作用。持有期货的商品ETF每次展期都会产生损益，所以收益可能和现货价格走势偏离。
businessTips.exampleEn: On October 20 the expiring November WTI contract settled at $101.79 while December traded near $98.28, a gap of about $3.50 that signals a tight physical market. An oil ETF rolling from November to December in that situation sells high and buys lower, which is a positive roll yield.
businessTips.exampleZh: 10月20日，即将到期的11月WTI合约收于101.79美元，而12月合约约98.28美元，近3.5美元的价差说明实货市场偏紧。这时原油ETF从11月展期到12月，相当于高卖低买，能获得正的展期收益。
